mapper.select: select * from ( select bgd.id as id, bgd.D_Code as code, '工程变更审批单' as type, bgd.D_PId as pId, bgd.D_CId as conId, ifnull(IFNUll(bgd.D_BL,100) - (select ifnull(sum(co_glbl),0) from bg_contactorder where co_glid = bgd.id and state = 7),100) as BL, bgd.D_Money as Money, bgd.final_confirm_money as finalConfirmMoney from bg_declaration bgd where bgd.state = 7 and bgd.D_CId = #{request.conId} and bgd.id not in (select vo_GLID from BG_VisaOrder where state = 7) and bgd.d_Ischeck = '涉及工程量调整/返工等及单价确认' ) t where t.BL > 0
select Sum(D_Money * IFNUll(D_BL,100) / 100 ) from BG_Declaration where State = 7 and D_CId = #{conId} and (D_BL != 0 or D_BL is null) and id not in (select vo_GLID from BG_VisaOrder where state = 7)

select bgd.id as id, bgd.D_Code as code, '工程变更审批单' as type, bgd.D_PId as pId, pp.P_Name as pName, bgd.D_CId as conId, cc.Con_Name as conName, (100 - IFNUll(bgd.D_BL,100)) as BL, bgd.D_Money as Money, IFNUll(bgd.D_BL,100) as TrueBL, (bgd.D_Money * IFNUll(bgd.D_BL,100) / 100 ) as TrueMoney from BG_Declaration bgd left join Con_Contract cc on cc.Con_Id = bgd.Con_Id left join pre_project pp on pp.P_ID = bgd.P_Id where bgd.State = 7 and (bgd.D_BL != 0 or bgd.D_BL is null) and bgd.id not in (select vo_GLID from BG_VisaOrder where state = 7)
and INSTR(bgd.D_Code,#{request.code})
and INSTR(cc.con_name,#{request.conName})
and likePname(#{request.pName},pp.P_Id)=true
and INSTR(pp.p_name,#{request.pName})
